ideas.idea: Render blog list on the server and give each post its own page/URL
ideas.why: The blog is client-fetched in useEffect with no per-post pages, so posts exist neither as server text nor as links.

ideas.idea: Add actual plans and prices as text on /pricing
ideas.why: The page only says 'Free for up to three people' despite describing plans for every team size, so concrete plan text helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Expand the thin /docs page with real setup steps
ideas.why: The docs page has a single sentence, so real steps would give people and machines something to read and quote.
No structured data exists and the site's identity (Ledger, origin) could be declared in a machine-readable way.

ideas.idea: Give /blog its own distinct title and description
ideas.why: /blog has no metadata so it inherits the home page's title and description, which is accurate per the layout.
Accurate since no lastmod exists, but it has little effect for a four-page site.
The sitemap is hand-kept, but with four routes this is a minor maintainability point that applies to most Next.js sites.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical to /blog via a server layout/page
ideas.why: /blog has no canonical, and the report correctly notes the client component can't export metadata.

ideas.idea: Remove the canonical/noindex contradiction on /pricing (canonical points at a noindex page)
ideas.why: This restates the known /pricing noindex-in-sitemap problem.
